questions.text: Why does the writer write the passage?
options: To ask the readers to avoid doing confusing things to dogs
To inform the readers that dogs can stay at home or be taken out
To remind the readers that dogs are social and olfactory animal
To tell the readers about dogs’ confusion over things we do
To describe dogs’ unique behaviors in general
questions.correctAnswer: To tell the readers about dogs’ confusion over things we do

questions.text: The best summary of the ideas in the passage is …
options: Though dogs are highly flexible, they must learn to cope with many challenges of living in our world.
As dogs are social and olfactory animal, understanding some of our habits is difficult for them.
Dogs are born socialites and olfactory, changing our shape and smell are confusing for them.
Besides being social and olfactory animals, dogs also have a habit of changing their coasts at least once a year.
Since our dogs’ behaviors are unique, they are adaptable enough to live with us though some things we do make them puzzled.
questions.correctAnswer: Though dogs are highly flexible, they must learn to cope with many challenges of living in our world.

questions.text: According to the text, which of the following statements is correct?
options: Female unemployment declined in the U.S. during the Great Depression
There was no correlation between the decline in marriage rates and the number of single women looking for work
Women could find work in the fields of health care, education, and security
Secretarial roles were diminished in FDR’s administration
Over 29 states had imposed marriage bars on their employment
questions.correctAnswer: Women could find work in the fields of health care, education, and security

questions.text: Which statement is correct regarding single women during the Great Depression?
options: They were paid according to their work
They had no family dependents
They had flexible hours and the option to work freely
They were more likely to find work than married women

questions.correctAnswer: They were more likely to find work than married women
